opening_message: I can't talk properly and my left side won't move right.

disclosure_items.first_person_phrasing: I can hardly get the words out, they come out all slurred.
I think one side of my face is sagging.
I can't move my left arm and leg properly.
I was totally fine an hour ago.
I haven't eaten anything, but they said my blood sugar is fine.
I don't know the number, but my blood pressure felt very high.
They gave me some kind of score and said it was 13, I'm not sure what it means.
I don't know my pulse, I just feel weak.
My breathing feels fine, around 18 breaths a minute.
